correctness.rationale: For all one-negative partial matrices, the negative entry contributes at least delta squared, and each saturated affected row/column contributes at least delta squared/2, attained by an explicit doubly substochastic point. Strict convexity gives uniqueness. Complete matrices reduce to a canonical three-by-three plus identity block; a nonnegative bistochastic projection is proved by exact row/column potentials satisfying all KKT inequalities, and all distance terms and multiplicities are counted. Exact rational and independent QP checks corroborate boundaries and examples.
